Warm sandstone, green-weathered copper dome, brass accents. One academy on a small square paved base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no people, no statues of people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.
